reply.content:
**10.3%**

Calculation: average of the FY2019–FY2021 operating income margins  
= \[(1,306 ÷ 11,503) + (509 ÷ 11,303) + (2,112 ÷ 14,082)\] ÷ 3 × 100  
= **10.3%**. The income statement reports net sales and operating income for each year (p. 65).
